lead_intro: Learn about the historical evolution of diseases and pandemics from the time of hunter-gatherers to the present day.

quiz.question: Which disease is considered the second pandemic of bubonic plague?
quiz.explanation: The Black Death is considered the second pandemic of bubonic plague, originating in the steppes of Central Asia.

quiz.question: In what year did the World Health Organization declare COVID-19 a pandemic?
quiz.explanation: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020.

quiz.question: Which disease was eradicated over two centuries after the introduction of the first form of vaccine?
quiz.explanation: The smallpox disease was eradicated over two centuries after the introduction of the first form of vaccine using cowpox.

quiz.question: Which disease causes severe diarrhea resulting in life-threatening dehydration?
quiz.explanation: Cholera is a bacterial infection that causes severe diarrhea resulting in life-threatening dehydration.

quiz.question: Which disease was identified by the Pasteur Institute in Paris in 1983?
quiz.explanation: The Pasteur Institute in Paris identified the HIV virus that causes AIDS in 1983.
